name: file-diff
title: File Diff
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Unified diff with added and removed lines, and collapsible runs of unchanged lines.

meta.descriptionEs: Diff unificado con líneas agregadas y eliminadas, y bloques sin cambios que se pueden colapsar.

examples.title: Vista de diff
examples.description: Diff unificado con líneas agregadas y eliminadas, y bloques sin cambios que se pueden colapsar.

api.name: patch
api.description: Unified diff text. Ignored when lines is set.

api.name: collapseAfter
api.description: Collapse unchanged runs longer than this. Default 5.

api.name: labels
api.description: expand, collapse, additions, and deletions labels default to English.

docs: Additions use the primary token and deletions use destructive. parseUnifiedDiff is exported. No theme is shipped.
